entry.title: CPI for all items increases 0.6% in September; gasoline rises
entry.content: In September, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers rose 0.6 percent, seasonally adjusted (SA), and rose 3.7 percent over the year.

entry.title: CPI for all items falls 0.1% in June
entry.content: In June, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers fell 0.1 percent, seasonally adjusted.
